actual_rule_observed: eleventyExcludeFromCollections: true removes the page from collections.all and therefore from the navigation, while the page is still written to the output directory.
notes: Docs: set eleventyExcludeFromCollections to true "to opt out of specific pieces of content added to all collections" and "This will not be available in `collections.all`". Confirmed: ProbeFour absent from nav; neighbours Home/Archive/About/Feed kept indices 0-3. Nuance observed: the page was still rendered to _site/probe-p4/index.html — the flag excludes it from collections only, not from output. Page deleted after probe to restore baseline.
